{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Hardy Harrow''''' was a [[carvanium]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] ship, owned by [[Denon-Ardru Mutual]], that disappeared on [[Ord Sigatt]]. The ship was captured and hidden by [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] and his friends to protest the tyrannical rule of Denon-Ardru Mutual on the planet.
